open_points.subject: runs.read_run / Run answer persistence
open_points.text: "The run's answer — status, outputs, and per flow output its value or the reason `skipped_by_guard` or `not_produced` (A13 rule 7) — is computed by `runs` from the trace when asked and is not stored" vs "the run's status and WaitingPoints M20 are derived from them and written by `runs` in its next store call."
open_points.question: Which parts of run state are persisted in Run M19 and which are recomputed on read?
options: Persist status/waiting/produced outputs in M19 and recompute only per-output reasons
Persist nothing run-state-like and derive full answer from NodeExecution/EffectAttempt trace each read
Persist status/waiting only; treat outputs as derived
open_points.default_guess: Persist status and waiting points (as stated elsewhere), persist produced outputs, and recompute only `skipped_by_guard`/`not_produced` reasons.

open_points.subject: installation token re-read trigger
open_points.text: "the re-read of the token list on every request when the file's digest changes"
open_points.question: What must happen on a request when the configuration file cannot be read (so digest comparison itself cannot be completed)?
options: Treat unreadable file as a failed re-read and enter/keep the "no valid list" state that refuses all requests
Only re-read on digest change; if unreadable without detected change, keep last valid list
open_points.default_guess: Follow A16 strictly: unreadable file causes failed re-read semantics and refusal of every request until a valid re-read passes.

open_points.subject: effects grant applicability to run-pinned flow version
open_points.text: "a send uses a grant for the run's pinned version (A10 rule 1)."
open_points.question: How does `effects` obtain the authoritative run-pinned `flow_version_id` needed to validate grant applicability, given `effects` does not know `runs`?
options: `runs` passes pinned version and node context into `effects.reach_operation_element` and `effects` trusts that call context
Expose a `runs` read capability to `effects` (would change dependency direction)
open_points.default_guess: Have `runs` pass the pinned version and element context explicitly into `effects` calls.

open_points.subject: functions.add_captured_trial_case contract-version check
open_points.text: "it then calls `functions.add_captured_trial_case`, which checks that the record's pinned contract version is the one named"
open_points.question: From where does `functions` get the authoritative pinned contract-version fact for that execution record, without reading `runs`-owned records through a forbidden direction?
options: `runs.capture_failed_execution` passes the pinned contract-version as trusted input and `functions` validates only consistency with provided case data
`functions` reads NodeExecution directly from `store` despite the stated read-through-owner rule
Move the pinned-version check fully into `runs` and let `functions` only validate/add the case
open_points.default_guess: `runs` supplies the pinned contract-version context to `functions`, and `functions` does not independently fetch `runs` trace records.
